items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: Yeah, I think we did some nice ballads with Joe. We had an orchestra with strings and we did some small group things.

ctx.x: Yeah, I think we did some nice ballads with Joe. We had an orchestra with strings and we did some small group things. That was one of the great things about doing the studio work was that along with all of the garbage that they throw at you, there is all these wonderful people coming through New York all the time to make records and I think he did this nice album — Joe Hunter wrote the arrangements. And right shortly after I arrived in New York City, in 1954, Buck Clayton was contracted to do these jam session…
